item.title: Poolin, Once One of Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pools, Files for Bankruptcy
item.description: The Singapore-based pool never recovered from freezing withdrawals in 2022. Now it's auctioning off its last Texas mining sites to pay back 11,700 users still holding IOUs.

item.title: Crypto advocacy groups support CLARITY passage as ethics rules face pushback
item.description: The window for US lawmakers to address a comprehensive crypto market structure bill before the 2026 elections is closing, and industry organizations are calling for action.

item.title: Nvidia, Meta, and Microsoft Tell Washington: Don't Kill Open-Source AI
item.description: Twenty-five companies signed a letter defending open-weight models days after a Chinese AI helped Hugging Face survive a hack triggered by OpenAI's own systems.

item.title: Strategy Overhauls Bitcoin Metrics, Debuting 'Net Bitcoin Per Share'
item.description: The firm says its "digital credit" shift needs new yardsticks that strip out debt and preferred claims to show what common shareholders own.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $225M, Snapping Seven-Day Inflow Streak as Iran Tensions Spook Markets
item.description: BlackRock's IBIT led the exit as Bitcoin briefly dipped under $65,000 and stocks fell on renewed US-Iran hostilities—though the week still closed in the green.

item.title: Internet Freedom Foundation calls India’s BitChat GitHub takedown order ‘unconstitutional’
item.description: The digital rights group says India’s order to remove Jack Dorsey’s BitChat repositories from GitHub exceeds the government’s legal authority and threatens free speech.

item.title: Crypto Biz: Is the AI-to-crypto rotation underway?
item.description: Bitcoin ETF inflows, cooling AI momentum and potential regulatory progress under the CLARITY Act are fueling speculation that capital is rotating back into crypto.

item.title: World Foundation raises $52.5M in Pantera-led funding to expand World ID infrastructure
item.description: The organization sold locked WLD tokens to strategic investors as it seeks to grow its biometric identity network amid rising demand for human verification online.

item.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House

item.description: The project is moving away from basic network expansion to focus entirely on integrating its biometric screening devices across enterprise software suites.

item.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
